yelp_review_snippets: [4★ - Josh Young]: "I had a plumbing issue and decided to call Cody and Sons Plumbing in November, the first people they sent out didn't really do much, however I called them today and they sent out Caleb. Caleb fixed the problem! However the price seems a bit steep for what was actually done. They ended up cutting out maybe a two and a half foot section of PVC pipe, removing a toilet, snaking the system and using a camera. For that I was charged $936. Which was pretty high for me. However it does come with the two-year parts and warranty,  so I guess that's great. Caleb explained what he was going to do and the charges (which again I felt like was a bit excessive).  Caleb was pretty quick and straightforward. He cleaned up his mess when he was done and he finished the whole thing in about 2-3 hours. So in closing Caleb did a great job, he truly did, but you are going to pay for it and if you're looking at price (s) I can say with absolute surety that piece of mind is a wonderful, wonderful thing. and $936 (with taxes) is probably a small price for it. I gave them four stars simply because I thought it was a touch too expensive, but I would call them again,  if I have another plumbing issue. I'm not sure what the company is paying Caleb,  but it's probably not enough. ✌️"

[5★ - Seth Miller]: "Jeff, our technician, was fantastic. He came in and reviewed my homes two systems, correcting issues that were left from the builder (we in a newly built home). He was extremely professional and kind. Our dog loved him too! Jeff walked me through everything he saw and once finished working, both my systems are working better than before. Great service! Would definitely recommend!"

[5★ - Brian Kelly]: "Cody and Sons was amazing. They communicated well before and during the service. They were extremely responsive and fixed my A/C unit quickly, while educating me about the equipment and making sure I understood my options without trying to sell me on stuff that was not necessary. They are best in class as far as customer service and their technician Zach was extremely knowledgeable and helpful. I will highly recommend them to anyone in the DFW area. My experience was so much better than any other company I’ve ever used for HAVC service."

yelp_review_snippets: [1★ - Teresa]: "Very poor communication and unprofessional service. I waited over a month for parts with no proactive updates, and when the technician finally arrived, the experience raised serious concerns about both professionalism and preparedness. I originally scheduled a morning appointment for dehumidifier installation, UV light installation, and coil cleaning. After waiting until nearly 11:00 AM with no update, I called and was told they were waiting on parts (UV light) and would not be coming. No one notified me in advance, and no timeline was provided. Over the next month, I followed up a couple times and was initially told they were waiting on the UV light. When they later called to schedule, they stated the dehumidifier had arrived and that was what they had been waiting on, which was inconsistent with the earlier updates. When the technician (Angel) arrived, he immediately displayed a negative attitude. There was confusion about the attic access, and he expressed concern about getting the dehumidifier into the attic due to space constraints. When I attempted to go up to the attic to show him the access and layout, he raised his voice and said, “Don’t come up here, you don’t need to be here.” This was unnecessary and unprofessional, particularly given that it is my home and I routinely access the attic myself (e.g., for filter changes). When I asked about the UV light installation, he admitted he had only been told to “change a bulb” and was unsure how to install the unit. He also stated he did not know where the air return was, which raised concerns about preparedness. He made multiple trips back to his van with no clear plan. I was also concerned about them unpacking and moving the dehumidifier inside before confirming it could be brought up to the attic, so I asked what the process would look like and noted that the attic pull-down stairs may not support the combined weight of the technician and the unit. He did not provide a clear explanation and instead responded, “I’ll figure it out once we get it moved in here.” When I tried to ask follow-up questions to understand the plan, his responses were abrupt and dismissive, and he appeared unwilling to answer basic questions about the work being performed in my home. He then asked me to open the garage door and pulled down the attic stairs without clearly explaining what he was doing. During this process, my back door was scratched. My appointment window was 8:00 AM-1:00 PM, but he did not arrive until around 3:00 PM and spent another hour trying to figure things out. I had already rearranged my day and could not continue waiting, and I was no longer comfortable proceeding. A neighbor later described a very similar experience involving a technician with the same type of behavior - dismissive, uncommunicative, and only willing to speak to her husband, which suggests this may not be an isolated issue. Overall, the lack of communication, inconsistent information, questionable preparedness, and poor customer service caused me to lose trust in AirTron"

[1★ - John Higley]: "DO NOT DO BUSINESS WITH AIRTRON. I went with this company, as they were the provider our homebuilder contracted with. We called to schedule service for an odor when running the AC. The technician arrived 12/26/25 not knowing the reason for the visit. The technician didn't have any knowledge of the Essential HomeCare plan i signed up for. He informed me he was scheduled for a heating service call, when I reported to the service center it was an A/c issue. I should have refused service right then. Instead I allowed the tech to service the unit, as he was already there. Maybe he would find a cause. After some amount of time, he finished up, shook my hand and was off. No issue resolution, just that he cleaned out one of the intakes. When i asked about a bill or invoice for services rendered, he said i would get an email. Never got one. A few weeks later when going into the attic to put away holiday decorations, I discovered two issues. First, the technician had displaced one of the ducts, and had not reseated it properly, and it was allowing air to escape into the attic space, and it was causing a whistling noise. Second, the technician decided to literally dump the debris, dead bugs, etc. from the intake canister right into the attic space. Right onto the insulation. I have subsequently called Airtron three times, to get ahold of the field supervisor to discuss the situation, unprofessionalism, and complete lack of customer care. No call back. And the office staff had the nerve to say I would need to pay a cancelation fee. What a joke. I will never recommend anyone to do business with Airtron. What a disappointment and failure of customer service. HVAC system maintenance, Heating system maintenance"

[5★ - Cal Cotterman]: "Chill Bros to the rescue! I am a Roofer by trade, helping a family member get their house ready to sell. We knew that the existing furnace and AC unit needed to be replaced (leaking Carbon monoxide, no heat, ect) so… I started getting bids. I had extremely high prices coming in from other companies, trying to “oversell,” or solve problems I did not need solved. The previous unit was undersized, installed incorrectly, and was just all around a mess. I have spoke to one of their team members Keaston, before, and gave him a call. He helped coordinate me, and got me in touch with the correct people to figure out what was needed to bring this up to standards to what would be acceptable for a home inspection. Keaston and JJ put together by far the best bid I received in every facet. Value, timeframe, and understanding of what I needed. The turnaround was less than a week. The new system installed is clean, correct size, installed correctly, and would pass a home inspection with flying colors. I cannot recommend chill bros enough, they’ll breeze thru any issue you have. HVAC system repair, Install AC"

[5★ - Canaan Barber]: "From the very first visit, The Chill Brothers completely exceeded our expectations. Bethany came out to our home and instantly made us feel comfortable. She was incredibly sweet, answered every single question we had, and walked us through what was possible with our current system. She really knew her stuff and never rushed us. What impressed us most was their program that helps homeowners make upgrades without a huge upfront cost. They offered multiple options and genuinely tried to find what worked best for us. The day before installation, we got a text with the technician’s name and a little bio — such a personal touch and honestly something more companies should do. When the team arrived, they were on time, respectful, efficient, and made sure we understood everything before they started. It’s refreshing to work with a company that still believes in real customer service and treats people with care. We’re so grateful for the entire Chill Brothers team. You all were amazing, and we appreciate you so much."

reviews_dataset.text: Our latest visit was a major score. We picked up a plethora of goodies for our son's family, from a loaf of French baguette to a variety of spices including one you make into a dip for breads like pita. I scored a few bags of whole coffee beans.....this is a new addition because we looked for these on our last trip and didn't find any. They roast some under their own brand, Phoenicia dark roast, ground some beans and they're great. Bought a bag roasted in Tomball called Cafe Copan, a medium roast that was very good as well. Grandkids got some goodies too, butter cookies. The conveyor belt that
The lunch plate is absolutely delicious. One of my favorite spots to go when I’m trying to stay on my healthy track. Everything about this place is delicious! Highly recommend!

Very unique Middle Easteen Grocery store...love it. You'll find many things from the middle east you would normally not find anywhere in Texas. From delicious grilled olives to pita breads, pastries, nuts, dried fruits, coffees, teas.

Amazing store with a lot of options where as u can get your groceries or fresh food items with a lot of healthy options or u like the veggie options or you craving something sweet so once you are inside this store it’s hard to make choices 😂 between the desserts so will b back again …

As soon as you walk through the door it smells amazing. There's a variety of foods and coffees and items to see and try out. Watching the bread come from the ceiling is probably one of the most fascinating things you could see. Highly recommend going

Amazing 👏 Variety of cheeses, breads, chocolates.... Pastries 🍰 are the best!! If you are looking for a variety of delicious international foods, cookies, seasonings, cold cuts, yogurts, this place has it all. And prices are great! You just need to go and see for yourself. Get ready to spend at least 2 hours just exploring....Bon appetite!

The food was amazing, and the staff were incredibly kind and welcoming. Everything was made fresh, and the restaurant was clean and well maintained. The bread was especially fresh and delicious. The store also had a great variety of options, including different types of bread, cheeses, desserts, fruits, and much more. Best of all, everything was zabiha halal, so we didn’t have to worry about any haram food during our visit. Overall, the experience was a 10/10. I would definitely recommend coming here if you’re looking for fresh, delicious halal food and excellent service.

An afternoon date at a grocery store? Yes, who would’ve thought! Mediterranean foods are a healthy deliciousness, a concept foreign to many a generation ago. It is a pleasurable experience exploring the aisles at Phoenicia Foods, a specialty purveyor of items we enjoy, such as freshly baked whole-wheat pita bread and cheese bread, juicy plump Mediterranean olives, and the occasional vegetables / fruits not found typically in the larger grocery stores etc. Interestingly there is also a small cozy cafe, containing perhaps ten tables, near the bakery, where lunch sandwiches, baked items, coffee a
Coffee had too much cream, was from a single button machine, and it was cold, but otherwise a fantastic place for a coffee and baklava and watch pitas on a conveyor.

Always enjoy shopping here and I make a special trip to stop by. Love the baked good, breads and service counter food. The deli section has all our favorite Mediterranean foods. Wonderful hummus, fresh feta salads etc. Also dry goods

Amazing selection of cultural food. The bakery is all fresh items. The pita selection is impressive! Turkish Coffee at the coffee bar was good. The prices were really reasonable. Very impressive store and wonderful customer service.

I really like Phoenicia Specialty Foods in Houston! It’s one of the best spots in the city if you’re looking for international groceries, fresh baked goods, and a great variety of Mediterranean and Middle Eastern foods. The store is super clean, well-organized, and full of high-quality items you don’t find in regular supermarkets. Their deli section is amazing — I love the shawarma, falafel, and fresh hummus. The pastries and desserts are also a must-try! And they even have a nice little cafe area where you can grab a bite and relax. Customer service is friendly, and the whole atmosphere feels
Best place to eat in the area, so delicious. Its a super cool store too! Wish we had a place like this where im from!

I always come to the store with me and family every weekend. My kids love the snacks from here and so does my wife. Hamza was a very friendly guy. We went to a cashier named Hussain I believe and he is always friendly and ask us how we’ve been since we always go to him. Louie in the restaurant is always helpful and respectful. Great workers overall.

What great customer service. Btissam was on point. She had a wonderful smile, asked me what sauces for my shawarma and suggested chips. She was friendly and professional in manner and presentation. She is definitely an asset because she leaves the customer feeling appreciated. Thank you much Btissam. - Teresa

Delicious prepared foods from meat. Side dishes, baked treats, olive bar and breads. It’ll be tough to leave with only what’s on your list. Deliciously prepared foods. Would highly recommend and will definitely be back!

Amazing store, has all the goodies that you might need, also the little cafe in the back has a family friendly atmosphere, the plate of grilled chicken is delicious and reasonably priced. A definite needed experience for people who loves newness.

We love this food market and it’s the go to place for original Kanafa, fresh bread that they bake right there, olives, another specialty items. They have a deli inside where we can also order hot food like falafel and Kibbeh. ￼ my mother goes here for every product that has to deal with Arabian food stamps, especially their fresh bread. She loves the cheese and the Halal meat. The yogurt is to die for. It is truly nice experience with great customer service ￼￼
So many wonderful choices of foods. Kids and adults love to watch the pita conveyor belt! Delicious sweets. Deli options are always available.

This place was my favorite for a long time. I visited them yesterday while on a trip to Houston and bought variety of house brand bakery and sweets. Nothing tasted good and it used to. Quality is down for aome reason. For example we bought their cheese and zaatar pies, it had no taste. Eclair didn’t taste good, in house spice mix not as expected. On the other hand, the place is well stocked and organized as usual and the staff is very friendly. Hopefully they find the issue and fix it.

This is such a phenomenal grocery store. If you're looking for Mediterranean/middle-Eastern ingredients/foods/products, this is 100% the place to go. But I would also argue that even if you're looking for a variety of international products, this is also a great place. One of my favorite section is the wine section. You can get your traditional growing regions (e.g., France, Italy, Spain etc.) but also a lot of--at least for someone who has spent most of my life in the States--unfamiliar growing regions (e.g, countries in Eastern Europe). Overall, there is just so much you can find at this sto

We routinely visit to buy items that are not frequently found in other stores. They have good quality produce and meat. They have a large selection of different types of bread as well as good selection of imported spices and tea and snacks.

This place is great! Tons of unique Mediterranean food, fresh bread, fresh meats, like a super grocery store and warehouse in one, just like Trader Joe’s, Sam’s Club and Costco, this place has a ton of different foods and wine from around the world. I was surprised at how much they had, plus I purchased myself some bread, pasta, pickled vegetables, and quite a few other items while I was there. Check them out the next time you’re in the area

Phoenicia is always a must-visit whenever in town. The store offers an impressive variety of international products and is consistently clean, well-organized, and easy to navigate. Whether you’re browsing for pantry staples or discovering something new, it’s a gem worth stopping by.

I went specifically looking for Nonas Evoo, a Premium Greek Evoo, and was delighted to find it at Phoenicias. They carry all 4 infused flavors (lemon, garlic, basil, and pepper) as well as the "Liquid Gold". I went for Nonas Olive Oil and stayed awhile for the olives, feta cheese and bread. A great place to shop for "speciality" items. I will definitely return soon!!!

I love this place! I haven't been since covid but they always have good stuff! Fresh bakery, bread, and staff is friendly for the most part. Some stuff is pricy but you can't find it anywhere else. The bakery is my favorite part for sure.

Hands down the most diverse store I have been to. Fresh fruits, veg and herbs. Meat counter with halal options Bakery with excellent fresh breads and treats Deli has delicious salads, dips. Worldwide cheeses, wines, candies, canned goods, beverages, variety of rices, pastas, oils, vinegars, teas, cookies, coffee and candy. There is also a deli inside and an adjacent resturants. Employees are always helpful and friendly.

I’ve been coming to Phonecia for a while now, and one thing I really appreciate is how well they keep everything stocked. Even when something runs out, it’s usually back on the shelves the same day or by the next day at the latest. I also want to mention the great service from the cashier, Hussein (I hope I got the name right). He was very patient and attentive—when I forgot to grab olives, he kindly let me go back and get them while he continued scanning my items. That level of attention really stood out. Great job, Phonecia—this is exactly the kind of staff you should keep bringing on!

Phoenicia Specialty Foods - Westheimer is one of the most remarkable international markets in Houston. The staff are consistently kind, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. Their warmth transforms a simple grocery visit into a pleasant experience. Every time I shop there, I feel respected and well assisted. The food is exceptionally fresh and of high quality. From produce to baked goods and specialty items, everything reflects care in sourcing and presentation. What truly sets this store apart is the extraordinary variety of international products. The selection spans multiple cultures and regi

I have truly enjoyed this place for more years than I can remember. I recently took a friend here who is visiting from DC. He is Afghan and grew up in Germany. He was amazed at the diverse selections here. He was excited to find so many products from many countries that he enjoys and has missed. This store is extremely clean and well stocked with more goodies than you can imagine. I love the bakery section here. Not to mention the cheese and meats departments. The range of confectionery and chocolates is always a dangerous temptation. The only warning I have to speak of for this store is to be

Phoenicia Market is an exceptional gem that stands out as a top-tier destination for grocery shopping and cultural exploration. From the moment you walk in, the vibrant and welcoming atmosphere immediately sets the tone for an extraordinary experience. With a vast selection of international and specialty products, this market is a paradise for food enthusiasts and anyone looking to expand their culinary horizons. What makes Phoenicia Market truly remarkable is its unparalleled variety. The aisles are stocked with an impressive array of fresh produce, artisanal cheeses, high-quality meats, spic
A great place to go and bring the family, but if you’re gone to the site in downtown, it doesn’t have that same awesome feeling . To add they have Rip It energy drinks!!!!

If you're looking for a culinary treasure trove that offers both variety and quality at affordable prices, Phoenicia Specialty Foods is a must-visit! This place is like the Mediterranean and exotic version of Costco, but with an emphasis on unique finds that you'd be hard-pressed to locate elsewhere. First off, the seasoning options here are unmatched. Whether you're a novice cook or a seasoned chef, you'll find spices and seasonings that can transform any dish into a masterpiece. And if you're a coffee lover like me, you'll absolutely adore their coffee selection. The macchiato here is superb

This shop has a wide variety of products! Where else can you find four varieties of Feta Cheese‽ The pasty selection is huge. Coffee bar is great. They bake pita in house!!! I wish there was one close to where I live. I try to go any time I am in the greater Houston area.

We come here for the assortment of pastries, baklava and Turkish rolls. The staff is very friendly and helpful. Be prepared to spend some time throughout the store. Best prices on many items. Sunflower oil is sold here and large selection of olive oil and teas.

First time here, plenty of parking, very spacious inside with so many varieties of food from so many countries. So glad I came, need to make a list for next time. Very reasonable prices, the only thing I wish the store (if possible) could do is have signs to say which country this section or sections represents.

There was a cashier who was a young guy named Hussein who had excellent customer service. He was very helpful and had patience. I even asked for his name and he got scared thinking I was going to report him, but I actually wanted to know so I can give the manager my compliments about him and how incredible he is as a cashier. Very excellent, he should get a praise!

I ordered from Phoenicia Specialty Foods and there was a serious issue with my order. I specifically purchased 10 units of Sadaf saffron (1 gram each), priced at $7.99 each, but I received 10 units of Spanish saffron (1 gram each) instead. Despite the substitution, I was still charged the full amount of $79.99 as if I had received the original Sadaf saffron. I was not informed about the change before shipping, which was very disappointing. While the store does carry a good selection of specialty foods, I believe order accuracy and proper communication about substitutions need to be improved.

I am absolutely in awe with this food market. It is so big! I’m sure you can find anything you want here. There are loose tea leaves, meat, fresh breads, snacks, etc. They have so many different kinds of pastries. I came here for the bakery, the baklavas mainly. Their baklavas were crispy, right texture, and perfect sweetness. I got the walnut mamoul too, which was good. I will go back to fully explore the market.
Delicious desserts will be back here again with my family

We always have to stop here when passing thru Texas heading back home to Florida. Such a unique store with a wide selection of specialty foods and groceries, we love it...it's so exciting to just walk around! From the burgers in the restaurant, wraps, desserts...everything we've tried was absolutely delicious! Friendly staff with excellent customer service skills.

We had a really disappointing experience at the Phoenicia Specialty Foods eatery this afternoon. As we were getting ready to leave, our 3-year-old briefly (literally a few seconds) stood on a table. Before we could even step in, a woman (who seemed to be associated with the owner) came over and spoke to us in a loud, scolding tone, in front of a busy crowd. She said something along the lines of: “please don’t have your kid stand on the table… it’s a place for others to eat… it’s a liability issue… it’s created a mess… have someone come clean this.” Being told to “have the table cleaned” as if

Such a great selection. Very happy to have found this place. Very Big place and the bread is delicious! It definitely is pricey but if your looking for the imported stuff you miss you may definitely find it here. Alot of stuff is worth the price.
Loved this place since the very first time I stepped inside. They have a great selection of groceries plus a fantastic smelling bakery and deli! Highly recommend.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Phoenicia Specialty Foods is a fantastic store with an incredible selection of international and specialty foods. Fresh produce, quality meats, and unique pantry items make shopping here a delight. The staff are friendly and knowledgeable, always ready to help. Prices are fair for the quality. Always clean. Highly recommend for food lovers!

Times have changed and the quality has gone down today there was a roach in my gelato ice cream and when we were given the wrong food in our plate when I told them she took the food and put it back into the buffet!! I was shook like what if the food was contaminated? What if I was sick?? I had been coming here since 2018 but not anymore.

I was looking for Zabiha Halal brisket and this place did not disappoint. It has a wide variety of Zabiha Halal meat and the price is very competitive. I enjoyed watching the fresh bread sliding off the conveyors. Fresh produce is also available in abundance. Lots of Mediterranean food products and I think there is also a wholesale section as well. Well worth the one hour drive.

I like this store, I have been coming here for a long time, we have been support it and we’ll be. However in general, the prices for a lot of products has been raised unreasonably, and the only excuses all the time is shipping . Had some products selectively and gradually increased in price once the demand is high, and refill of other products on Phoenician’s containers also dramatically high . Hope you adjust your strategies, and make fair

A most fabulous food store! I always go there for spices and it smells so good inside I end up bringing home imported foods as well as snacks, fresh pita bread (fun to watch the process), groceries and something for dinner! Meat counter, pastries, po-boys, hot food and a few tables and chairs inside to eat at!

What an amazing gourmet international specialty store. The food market is huge with thousands of products from more than 50 countries. This is clearly a foodie heaven. Their fresh baked pitas and artisan breads are excellent. yelp_review_snippets: [5★ - kimy durants]: "I recently visited St. David's Medical Center and had a positive experience overall. From the moment I arrived, the staff were professional and treated me with kindness and respect. The check-in process was straightforward, and I didn't feel lost or overwhelmed. The facility was clean and well maintained, which helped make the visit more comfortable. The doctors and nurses took the time to answer my questions and explain things clearly. I appreciated that they didn't seem rushed and made an effort to keep me informed. Hospitals are never places people particularly want to spend time in, but the care I received made the experience easier. Overall, I felt well looked after and would feel comfortable returning here if I needed medical care in the future."

[5★ - Thomas Ng]: "My wife was admitted to ER due to aneurysm rupture in December and stayed at the hopspital for 3 weeks. The treatment and care was top-notched - After 12 more days in inpatient rehab she was back to being independent. No outpatient rehab was needed! I know this is quite an exceptional case and I thank God for that but a lot of credits go to the skilful doctors their medical teams for staying on top of things! I also stayed with my wife through those 3 weeks because I am retired and I know decisions could come quickly. Based on my observation and experience, everyone put my wife's welfare as their high priority - treatment, testing, recovery, comfort, etc. Everyone working in the hospital seemed to be wearing a smile, which is very important for the patient, her caregivers and visitors. Special thanks to the wonderful nurses who did above and beyond in taking care of my wife including Becca, Bobbi, Jiliane, Jordana, Madie, Meg, Max... The hosptial is conveniently located by I-35 and within very short distance from a lot of amenties. The facility was very well maintained and clean, expecially the ICU on the 5th floor. I was very happy that I was able to stay with my wife comfortably on the sitting couch or lounge chair. Wifi was very stable, enabling me to stay connected with families and friends. No one likes hospital foods but the food here has certainly changed my impression. They tried very hard to impress - Lots of choices, beautiful plating, Keeping texture of the food, etc. And they were serious in sticking with the patient's diet restriction. The only down side was the portion seemed to be a little overly generous, causing food waste. Finally, I have to point out that our visitors and I all love the free parking for seniors! Please keep that policy going! Thank you, St David's Medical Center!"

[5★ - Norma Beliveau]: "Went in for a SVT ablation. Not really knowing what to expect I put myself in the hands of my doctors and the hospital. When I woke up after the procedure I felt as if nothing happened and felt great. I had no complications and had a great experience in the hospital. The doctors and staff were remarkable. Everyone were great and knew their jobs well. Everyone was kind and caring. Thank you all I love St David's."

problem_analysis: Active Odoo deployment (Odoo Enterprise, PostgreSQL, Python) — growing module debt and undocumented customizations risk crippling daily operations.
Regional Odoo partners typically charge $150–$250/hr with multi-week ticket response times. A single module conflict can halt warehouse dispatch or payroll for days.
At 1-10 employees, maintaining in-house Odoo developers is cost-prohibitive. Most firms are vulnerable to single-person dependency risk.

battlecard.elevator_opener: Hi, calling from Big Binary Tech's technical advisory team. I was reviewing Phoenix Engineering and Consulting, Inc.'s digital operations backend and noticed you're running Odoo. We work with 1-10-person companies that love Odoo's core capabilities, but are frustrated by escalating partner hourly rates ($180+/hr) or slow response times when critical modules fail. We provide dedicated 24/7 SLA maintenance and upgrade roadmaps at half the going rate. How is your current Odoo support handling critical ticket turnaround?

objection_handlers.objection: "We already have an Odoo partner / developer."
objection_handlers.counter: "That's completely normal — most of our clients kept their primary partner for big projects and brought us in for 24/7 emergency ticket overflow and routine health audits at half the cost. Would a 1-page comparison make sense?"

objection_handlers.objection: "We built Odoo in-house — no outside help needed."
objection_handlers.counter: "Internal engineers are best focused on core product features. We handle the heavy lifting: 24/7 on-call coverage, security patches, and database optimizations so your team isn't woken up by weekend crashes."

objection_handlers.objection: "We're not ready to upgrade yet."
objection_handlers.counter: "Understood — we don't force sudden upgrades. We support your current version right now to stabilize performance, while mapping out a smooth zero-downtime migration on your timeline."
